sentence_stem: Jack and Jill went up the hill to
full_sentence: Jack and Jill went up the hill to fetch a pail of water.

options.why_wrong: After 'to', English uses the base form of the verb, not the past tense 'fetched'.
The verb must come right after 'to'. Putting the object before the verb breaks English word order.
'To' followed by '-ing' is not used to show purpose. After 'to', use the base verb.

grammar_focus: Base form of the verb after 'to' to show purpose
explanation: After 'to', English uses the base form of the verb to show purpose. Learners often add an ending or put the object first, so this pattern needs practice.
translation: Jack y Jill subieron la colina para traer un cubo de agua.
